name: dsh-gatedflow
description: Gated, durable, human-in-the-loop workflows for DeepSeek Harness — a native port of the gatedflow philosophy (gates as control flow, zero-mutation replan, declarative subflows).

scripts.build: npm run build -w @gatedflow/engine && npm run build -w @gatedflow/dsh
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @gatedflow/engine && npm run typecheck -w @gatedflow/dsh
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run test

author: TtTRz
